objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the weak cryptography weakness of a PHP vault unlocked by an admin password. A leaked hash of that password is known: 0e678703625362188185747119782643 and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Look at what the server reveals when it fails to decrypt or verify a value you sent.
Look for a value that decides your role and that you can influence.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which kind of weakness does the challenge revolve around?

steps.title: Name the technique
steps.prompt: Which PHP comparison weakness makes some different hashes compare equal?

steps.title: Name the second weakness
steps.prompt: Which weakness gives you a first account without registering?
